paragraphs: Company Micro Harvest is helping with the growing need for more protein.

They use tiny living things in a closed space, called a Bioreactor. This is a quick way to make protein. Other ways usually take a long time. Micro Harvest finishes the process in just one day. The protein which they make has a good taste.

The protein can go into different foods, even for pets. Bakers want to start small, like in a local store or restaurant, and then grow. There are some rules to follow, but the company hopes that it will be possible to make food for people, too.

paragraphs: As global protein demand is expected to rise by 50% by 2050, traditional methods of production may strain the planet’s resources.

Micro Harvest, led by CEO Kate Bakers, explores alternatives using biotechnology and microorganisms to efficiently produce protein. Employing a rapid fermentation process, the company converts microorganisms into protein within a day, offering a sustainable and scalable solution. The resulting product, described as having a savory taste, lacks an aftertaste, making it versatile for various food applications, including pet foods.
Despite facing regulatory challenges, Micro Harvest aims to contribute to the protein market’s evolution, emphasizing the need for immediate action in light of current global challenges.

paragraphs: With a 50% increase in protein demand by 2050, Micro Harvest is exploring alternative protein production methods.

The company focuses on biotechnology and microorganisms in a closed system called a Bioreactor. They successfully change non-protein substances into protein. The company’s special process takes only one day. They make a product which has a savory taste without any bad feeling in your mouth after you eat it.
The company can produce large amounts of protein. They plan to sell their protein powder to factories which produce fish and pet food. Later, they wish to make food for people, too.
